text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... I love this tension in the air. It
makes it
really feel like things are
heating up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My heart is racing as if I've already
won... My
body must be predicting a
victory.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I can see it clearly when I close my
eyes—a
dazzling vision of me running
down the road of
glory, and us sharing
our joy together!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Our happy ending isn't far away!
